claim: 暖かい is glossed plain 'Warm' while every other temperature word in the deck says whether it is about weather or things, so the back drops the weather sense its own kanji card teaches and leaves it indistinguishable from the 温 'Warm (to the touch)' the learner already knows.
evidence: 暖かい back: 'Answer: Warm'. Same unit: 暖 'Answer: Warm (weather)', 涼しい 'Answer: Cool (weather)', 冷たい 'Answer: Cold (things; people)'. Earlier: 温 'Warm (to the touch)', 寒い 'Cold (weather, not used for things)', 暑い 'Hot (weather)', 熱い 'Hot (thing)'.
fix: Gloss it 'Warm (weather)' to match 暖, 涼しい and 暑い.

claim: Five suffix cards print a 〜 at the start of the romaji that the front does not carry, the first time any reading card in the deck has done this, so the Says line no longer matches the written form above it (the English already marks the slot with '...').
evidence: 方面 'Says: 〜hōmen' (r-c64f974fa90b), 番線 'Says: 〜bansen' (r-856d5830b52b), 週間 'Says: 〜shūkan' (r-ae5d2000edcb), 行き 'Says: 〜iki' (r-cd91af5d05a4), か月 'Says: 〜kagetsu' (r-370f0655dc10). Fronts: '方面', '番線', '週間', '行き', 'か月'. Earlier suffix-like card 時間 'Time; ... hours (duration)' has no 〜 in its romaji.
fix: Drop the 〜 from these five romaji lines (or have a romaji-style check catch a leading 〜), leaving the '...' in the English to mark the slot.
